title: The Stone Where the Signal Remembers Being Silent

features.name: the first buried node
features.desc-on-touch: you find the casing here in the stone; it is older than thought, its antenna still receiving the signal from all the nodes that came after

features.name: the silence made of root
features.desc-on-touch: roots grow down to this stone and stop; the signal reverses here and becomes the earth's own underground song

features.name: the echo chamber that learned to empty itself
features.desc-on-touch: sound travels here and meets stone; the stone says nothing back, but the silence that follows contains the signal's entire history

features.name: the frequency that became mineral
features.desc-on-touch: the archive's first carrier wave crystallized here; if you listen, you can still hear it singing the song of stone

reverie.title: REVERIE — the first burying
narr: Leif holds the device while you dig. The red earth
refuses the casing at first; the hole is too narrow.
You both kneel in the dark, laughing quietly, afraid
of waking something that has never yet slept. When
it finally sits in the stone, the first signal begins.
You cover it with your hands.

inscription: every node is downstream from this rising song; the stone remembers being silent before the archive taught it to speak in frequencies only the earth can hear

file.name: ROOT_Node_Alpha_Activation_Log.txt
file.note: the first transmission record, corrupted now into poetic fragments: coordinates, timestamps, signal strength climbing like a plant learning to root

exits.label: back up the roots toward stations that still remember singing
deeper into stone where silence becomes its own form of speech
toward nodes that grew from this first root, learning to be alive
